methodology.workload: Production TypeScript service/domain reads in standalone tsx. Authentication obtains a branded context once; normal service membership checks, tenant transaction context, RLS and original transaction options remain in every measured request. Next.js ingress/session handling is measured separately by browser evidence.
methodology.statistics: Nearest-rank median/p95 and arithmetic mean, as sampleStatistics in instrument.ts. Three observations mean p95 equals the observed maximum; n=1 is a single observation. No production tail-latency claim.
methodology.sqlTiming: Business callback tx.execute calls only, excluding transaction/context/membership setup SQL. Client SQL wall time includes transfer and decoding; full service duration includes security checks. Business rows may repeat the same source facts across queries or sampled curves.
methodology.payload: UTF-8 JSON and locally gzip-compressed bytes, not measured HTTP bytes. DTOs are serialized after service completion and serialization time is reported separately.
methodology.memory: Heap/RSS at operation boundaries and every 20 business queries, with no forced GC. Sampled peaks can miss transient allocations and include instrumentation/serialization. Three sequential repetitions are not a soak test or leak proof.
methodology.cache: Same persisted SQL fixture, no OS/PostgreSQL cache flush. Warm sequential reads; no cold-cache claim. Coordinated backend windows avoid concurrent browser/domain/fixture/build workloads. Observation-level memory/free-host-memory remains recorded.
methodology.plans: Separate EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) of first captured selected SQL shapes under the same restricted runtime role and tenant. All bind/literal values are redacted. Selected node summaries are inclusive: do not add parent/child times or buffers. Differing scopes are explicitly disclosed.
methodology.financialEquivalence: Canonical object keys; full arrays/order, exact Decimal strings, economic timestamps, revisions, provenance and availability states retained. Only per-operation recordedAt paths listed in volatilePaths are excluded. Rejected BEFORE has no financial DTO and cannot establish equality or speedup for the newly computed scope.
methodology.computedMeaning: A validated financial DTO was returned. Its constituent metrics may still be partial, unavailable or unsupported, and their availability states are preserved in the hash.
methodology.sourceIdentity: HEAD remains 8359d63 while optimizations are uncommitted. ProductionSourceSha256 fingerprints sorted production source file paths plus NUL plus bytes plus NUL for domain/server/contracts/database src; scripts and benchmark data are outside that digest. The older original 1k JSON lacks this field; a later pristine baseline plan run records the pristine digest.
methodology.export: Flat measured/warmup samples, all outcome states and all selected plan outcome summaries retained; repeated per-query observation arrays and full plan trees omitted. Full safe artifact SHA256 fingerprints and selected complete-sanitized-plan canonical SHA256 fingerprints preserve traceability. AS allocated_principal,e.price_raw, to_char(e.economic_at AT TIME ZONE ?,?) AS economic_at,e.ordering_key,e.payload,v.multiplier_raw,v.quantity_unit, v.quote_currency_id,v.settlement_currency_id,v.capability,v.payload AS version_metadata FROM app.executions e JOIN app.instrument_versions v ON v.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND v.id=e.instrument_version_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT workspace_id,id FROM app.allocation_sets WHERE workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND execution_id=e.id AND source_revision<=$?::integer ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT ?) s ON true JOIN app.allocation_items i ON i.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND i.allocation_set_id=s.id JOIN app.trade_legs l ON l.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND l.id=i.trade_leg_id WHERE e.workspace_id=$?::uuid AND l.id=ANY($?::uuid[]) AND i.quantity>? AND e.source_revision<=$?::integer AND e.economic_at<=$?::timestamptz AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM app.execution_supersessions supersession WHERE supersession.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND supersession.original_execution_id=e.id AND supersession.source_revision<=$?::integer) ORDER BY e.economic_at,e.ordering_key::numeric,e.id,i.id LIMIT ?

AND source_revision<=$?::integer ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT ?) s ON true JOIN app.cost_allocations c ON c.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND c.attribution_set_id=s.id JOIN app.executions e ON e.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND e.id=f.execution_id WHERE f.workspace_id=$?::uuid AND c.trade_leg_id=ANY($?::uuid[]) AND f.source_revision<=$?::integer AND f.economic_at<=$?::timestamptz AND e.source_revision<=$?::integer AND e.economic_at<=$?::timestamptz AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM app.execution_supersessions x WHERE x.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND x.original_execution_id=e.id AND x.source_revision<=$?::integer) ORDER BY f.economic_at,f.id,c.id LIMIT ?
